fixed.explanation: In innerAsLocators for internal:role, name and description each set options.exact from attr.caseSensitive and throw when they differ. A regex value has no meaningful case-sensitivity flag, so mixing a regex with a string produces a bogus conflict. The exception is caught in asLocatorDescription, which returns the raw selector. The fix checks and sets exactness only for string values.

input.intent: Locator/selector to-string conversion: converts internal selector (internal:role=... with name and description attributes) into a readable locator string like getByRole('button', { name: /x/, description: 'y' }). The conversion fails to handle mixed regex/string name and description, falling back to raw selector.
input.symptom: Role locators with regex name and string description (or vice versa) print as raw internal:role selector instead of readable getByRole locator.
